name: Estinien Varlineau
oracle_text:
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, put a +1/+1 counter on Estinien Varlineau. It gains flying until end of turn.
At the beginning of your second main phase, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of your opponents who were dealt combat damage by Estinien Varlineau or a Dragon this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your second main phase, you draw X cards and lose X life, where X is the number of your opponents who were dealt combat damage by Estinien Varlineau or a Dragon this turn.

needs.what: a player spec (or value) naming the opponents dealt combat damage this turn by this creature OR by any creature with a given subtype (Dragon, any controller, subtype read when the damage was dealt), so X can be counted as the number of distinct such opponents -- e.g. {"dealt_combat_damage_by": {"any_of": ["self", {"subtypes": ["Dragon"]}]}} plus a value that counts the players a player spec resolves to
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `dealt_combat_damage_by` player spec takes only "self" and stands alone (loader.effects._validate_player_spec refuses any other subject), and its ledger `players_dealt_combat_damage_by` is keyed by attacker oid without the attacker's subtypes at damage time; the `combat_damage_by` condition (prowl) reads `combat_damage_types`, a game-wide yes/no over subtypes that records no seat and cannot count opponents; no value key counts the players a player spec resolves to. The first sentence (spell_cast trigger, add_counters + grant_keyword flying) is expressible on its own
